title: De-flake largetimeline.test.ts wall-clock perf assertion
description: packages/core/src/**/largetimeline.test.ts has a wall-clock performance assertion (expects an operation < ~5ms) that intermittently fails under parallel CI/agent load (observed 10.3ms) while passing in isolation. This is a flaky test, not a real regression. Fix: replace the brittle absolute wall-clock threshold with a robust measure — e.g. a generous ceiling, an operation-count/complexity assertion, warmup + median of N runs, or mark it a non-gating perf benchmark. Acceptance: the test no longer fails under concurrent load and still guards against real O(n^2)-style blowups. Reference: surfaced by the task 1381 agent.
